However, mākaka and kōwhai seeds survived up to 80°C, and mākaka seeds even sprouted in response. Māhoe, tī kōuka (cabbage tree) and matagouri seeds died after heating, while invasive gorse survived 100°C and sprouted. item.description: Police are investigating the death of a man found stabbed in North Albury last month. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Budding rocket scientists put designs to the test in outback competition
item.description: Domestic and international students turn a remote sheep station into a testing ground for their designs as they compete in the Australian Universities Rocket Competition. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Bill Ormonde and Sarah McConnell

item.title: Australian Army soldier dies in training exercise
item.description: An Australian Army soldier has died and five others have been injured during a training exercise at Mount Bundey, south-east of Darwin. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Man carjacked at knifepoint on Sunshine Coast, sparking 160km police chase
item.description: Two men have been charged over an alleged carjacking on the Sunshine Coast that led to a police pursuit through the evening. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Landmark gorge reopens to visitors after 'huge job' fixing flood damage
item.description: Danggu Geikie Gorge is welcoming its first visitors in more than three years, after the devastating Fitzroy River Floods destroyed almost all its infrastructure. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.description: The new pick-up and drop-off zones have largely met with passenger approval on the first morning of operation. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Court hears man ran over partner with Range Rover, causing brain injury
item.description: The Northern Territory Supreme Court has heard a woman suffered life-threatening injuries, including facial fractures, brain bleeds and wounds to her body after being run over by her partner in rural Darwin. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Olivana Lathouris

item.title: Record sheep prices can't save saleyard despite $1 lease offer
item.description: Despite record sheep prices the Jerilderie saleyard will be decommissioned after Murrumbidgee Council failed to find anyone to take over its 20-year lease offered for just $1 per year. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Emily Doak and Cara Jeffery

item.title: Mary Fowler withdraws from Matildas squad for Germany, Haiti games
item.description: Mary Fowler will be replaced by Leah Davidson for the upcoming friendlies, with the Matildas star withdrawing due to personal circumstances. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Live: Wantaway Saints star boycotts best and fairest as Cats eye AFL trade
item.description: St Kilda ruck Rowan Marshall does not attend the Saints' best and fairest event as he tries to force through a trade to Geelong. Follow all the news and debate from the AFL trade period in our live blog. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Trump's former press secretary Karoline Leavitt joins Fox News
item.description: Karoline Leavitt, the youngest person to hold the role of press secretary, is joining Fox News as an on-air contributor in November. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: WA has high hopes for Land Forces as anti-war activists prepare to protest
item.description: Australia's biggest defence expo is making its debut in Perth with the WA government saying it is important "strategically, commercially" as anti-war activists prepare to protest. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Courtney Withers

item.title: Best-selling UK novelist Jeffrey Archer dies days before latest book release
item.description: Jeffrey Archer was a best-selling author who sold more than 300 million copies worldwide, with his final novel due to be published this month. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Bird flu adds to fears for threatened species at proposed wind farm site
item.description: Victorian ecologists are warning of the "compounding risks" of bird flu and a proposal for the nation's tallest wind turbines on threatened species. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Violence-racked remote NT community appeals for social club trial
item.description: Residents of the Northern Territory's second-largest remote community are divided over whether a social club should be opened and serve alcohol, amid ongoing violence in the town. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Live: ASX rises, Nasdaq hits new record high
item.description: The Australian share market opens higher. The Nasdaq hit a record high after Wall Street's tech stocks surged. Follow the day's events and insights from our business reporters on the ABC News live markets blog. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.description: The Victorian region synonymous with boating, tourism and recreational camping is now home to a growing number of rough sleepers. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.description: The Office of the Information Commissioner says some of the breaches were malicious and intentional. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Live: Coalition expected to cut migration to 100,000 in first year if elected
item.description: The Coalition is expected to announce it will cut net overseas migration to 100,000 in its first year of government. Follow live. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Australia's migrant policy offers lessons for EU and US
item.description: Australia has used offshore processing centers to deter asylum seekers for more than two decades. As the EU and US pursue similar third-country arrangements, Australia's experience highlights the potential problems. Fuente: Deutsche Welle - World.

item.title: La mujer más rica de Australia acaba de gastarse 600 millones de dólares en golpear a China donde más duele
item.description: La mujer más rica de Australia ha colocado parte de su fortuna en una de las pocas compañías capaces de plantar cara a China en uno de sus negocios más estratégicos. Lynas Rare Earths , respaldada por Gina Rinehart como accionista mayoritaria, ha acordado comprar Meteoric Resources por 968 millones de dólares australianos, unos 600 millones de euros, y con ella hacerse con el proyecto Caldeira de Brasil. Bajo el suelo de Minas Gerais aparece así una nueva pieza en la carrera occidental por reducir una dependencia china que alcanza desde los coches eléctricos hasta los cazas y los misiles. Un… Fuente: Xataka.

item.title: Identifican una nueva especie de pingüino por primera vez en más de 100 años
item.description: El Pygoscelis kerguelensis, también conocido como pingüino papúa del sureste, vive en las remotas islas Kerguelén, a casi 2.000 kilómetros al norte de la Antártida. Fuente: BBC News Mundo.

item.title: Norway proposes temporary ban on smart glasses amid privacy fears
item.description: The push comes amid growing ethical and privacy concerns around the new devices, which have been marketed by technology giants such as Meta. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: 'Concerning' death of Russian 'plague' laboratory employee being monitored
item.description: The US says it is closely monitoring the death of an employee at a Siberian "anti-plague" laboratory from what Russian officials are calling pneumonia of an unknown origin. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Saudi-backed Yemeni forces claim control of Bab el-Mandeb Strait
item.description: The waterway in the Red Sea, which facilitates about 12 per cent of global trade, was seized by the Houthis last month. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Germany at risk of 'violent conflict' with Russia, intelligence chief warns
item.description: Germany risks entering a "violent conflict" with Russia because of Moscow's increasingly aggressive stance against European nations, an intelligence chief has warned. Publicado también por: Sky News - World. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
